events.name: Bash
events.head: Check keepalive state on disk
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/ops/ | grep -iE 'docker|tracker|launchd'; ls workshop-plan/ops/launchd 2>/dev/null | grep -i docker; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/ops/docker_keepalive.py; git status --short workshop-plan/ops/ | head; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -iE 'docker|mongo'; launchctl list | grep -iE 'docker|mongo|tracker'; tail -5 ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read keepalive script, plist and log
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cat workshop-plan/ops/docker_keepalive.py; cat workshop-plan/ops/launchd/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist; diff workshop-plan/ops/launchd/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist && echo SAME; wc -l ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log; grep -v 'ok: engine' ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log | tail -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check tracker_sync Mongo logging
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -nE 'unreachable|MongoDB written|ServerSelection|def write_mongo|mongo' workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py | head -30; grep -c 'MongoDB written' ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log; grep -iE 'mongo' ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit state, AutoStart, homebrew mongo, publish hold
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -2 -- workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist; git status --short workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist; diff workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist && echo SAME; grep -E 'StartInterval|<integer>|python|Log' -A0 workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist; S=~/Library/Group\ Containers/group.com.docker/settings-store.json; ls "$S" && python3 -c "import json,sys;pri

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify port binding and homebrew mongo plist
events.input: $ /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -iTCP:27017 -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -n +2; /usr/local/bin/docker ps --filter name=tantra-mongo --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}'; /usr/local/bin/docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' tantra-mongo; grep -A1 -E 'RunAtLoad|KeepAlive|bind|config' ~/Library/LaunchAgents/homebrew.mxcl.mongodb-community.plist | head; ls /usr/local/etc/mongod.conf /opt/homebrew/etc/mongod.conf 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -E 'port|bindIp' 2>/dev/null; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/homebrew.mxcl.mongodb-community 2>&1 | head -2; tail -1 ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log;

events.name: Bash
events.head: Quit Docker Desktop to test keepalive
events.input: $ ls /opt/homebrew/bin/mongod /usr/local/bin/mongod 2>&1 | head -2; osascript -e 'quit app "Docker"'; for i in $(seq 1 12); do /usr/local/bin/docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || break; sleep 5; done; date '+quit confirmed %H:%M:%S'; /usr/local/bin/docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo STILL_UP || echo ENGINE_DOWN; /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -iTCP:27017 -sTCP:LISTEN | wc -l

events.text: Quitting Docker Desktop to test the keepalive recovery; waiting for the engine to go down.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait until keepalive logs recovery
events.input: $ until tail -1 ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log | grep -qE '^2026-10-11 21:0[1-9].*(ok:|FAILED|was )'; do sleep 10; done; tail -4 ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log; /usr/local/bin/docker ps --filter name=tantra-mongo --format '{{.Status}} {{.Ports}}'; date

events.text: Meanwhile, the commit/push state: the keepalive script and plist are committed in f3f5f70e (another lane's commit swept them in). Local main is 2 ahead of origin/main.
